bio: Oulton Hall is a magnificent, Grade II listed, mid 18th century mansion with beautiful gardens, converted into Yorkshire's only 5-star luxury hotel.  Afternoon Tea is served by a traditional butler in the new Drawing Room , an elegant and luxury dining area.  The menu offers a selection of traditional savoury finger sandwiches and an array of scones and deserts to be enjoyed with tea, or you can upgrade your Afternoon Tea with a glass of Prosecco, a teapot of Hendrick's Gin or a glass of Moet.  Oulton Hall Hotel, Spa and Golf Resort is close to Rothwell and Methley, and is within close proximity of Leeds and Woodlesford train station.  Please note: Tables reserved for Afternoon Tea on a Friday , Saturday and Sunday are limited to a maximum of 2.5 hours stay.
